title: Flamingo Key | Vibrant 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Flamingo Key is a pet friendly 30A retreat with a private pool, in-law apartment, bikes, and a quick 2-minute walk to the beach near Seaside.
description_expanded: Flamingo Key A Block to the Gulf with Private Pool + In-Law Apartment Home Introduction Flock to Flamingo Key ! Just a 2-minute walk from door to sand at the Greenwood Beach Entrance, this spacious 6-bedroom retreat is perfectly designed for large families and groups looking to stay close to the Gulf. With a private pool, flexible in-law apartment, and refreshed interiors for 2026 , this 30A escape offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Home Highlights Updated for 2026 - New kitchen, new living room furniture, fresh paint, and refreshed landscaping Private Pool (24x12) with sun shelf + in-pool loungers - Heated October-April for an additional fee Spacious In-Law Apartment - Private entrance, kitchenette, 2 bedrooms + additional sleeping space (sleeps up to 6) Pet Friendly - Pre-approval + non-refundable fee required (up to 2 dogs, 60 lbs or less) Renovated Full Kitchen - Stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, pantry Dining for 14 - Table seating for 10 + breakfast bar seating for 4 Screened Front Porch - Cushioned sectional + dining table for 4 Covered Balcony - Rocking chairs + Adirondack seating Fenced & Landscaped Backyard - Lounge seating + outdoor dining area Outdoor Grill + Enclosed Outdoor Shower 6 Taxi Bikes Parking for 4 Vehicles (No RVs, trailers, or street parking permitted per HOA) Two Full Baths on 1st Floor (One in apartment + one off living room) 2nd Floor Laundry Center - Washer & Dryer Separate Temperature Controls for each floor + apartment Cable + WIFI Throughout Home Concierge Services Available - Beach chairs, grocery delivery, baby gear, golf carts, bike rentals, private chef Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Location Perks 2-Minute Walk to Greenwood Beach Entrance 3-Minute Bike Ride to Surfing Deer & Seagrove Village Market 5-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside shopping, dining & the famous Seaside Food Trucks Quick access to 30A's best coastal dining, shopping, and beach access points Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations 10+ days (included in rate) Pool heat available October-April for an additional fee HOA prohibits RVs, trailers, and street parking Concierge services available for add-ons including beach chair setups, grocery delivery, and private chef experiences ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, walk-in closet and dresser storage, sitting area, and a newly renovated ensuite bath with walk-in shower featuring bench, rain and spa shower heads,
1st Floor King Guest Room 2 in In-Law Apartment | TV, closet storage, adjacent to full bath with combination shower/tub
1st Floor Guest Room 1 in In-Law Apartment | Two Queen Beds (sleeps up to 4), TV, closet storage, adjacent to full bath with combination shower/tub

1st Floor Guest Room 2 | Twin daybed and Twin trundle off kitchen (sleeps 2), door for privacy, TV, closet storage. Nearby full bath with walk in shower off the living room. You do walk through this room to get to the in-law apartment.
2nd Floor Queen Suite | TV, closet and dresser storage, ensuite access to shared bath with combination shower/tub
2nd Floor Bunk Suite | Sleeps up to 6 in two Double over Double Bunks, TV, closet and dresser storage, ensuite access to shared bath with combination shower/tub

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
